place.zh: 外门演武场 · 五行台
place.en: The outer court training ground · the Five Elements Platform

setup.zh: 宗门大比，内门外门一起比。规矩只三条：掉下台的输，认输的输，执事看着不能再打了的输；半炷香分不出，执事看谁占上风。不许伤人性命。打进前四的进内门名册；头名，得全观一年就这一颗的筑基丹——外门三十年没人拿过。
setup.en: The sect contest, inner court and outer court together. Three rules only: off the stage loses, yielding loses, and if the steward judges you can't go on, you lose; if half a stick of incense settles nothing, the steward judges who has the upper hand. No taking a life. The last four go into the inner register; first place gets the one Foundation pill the whole temple has this year — and the outer court hasn't taken it in thirty years.

recap.zh: 腊月初八，宗门大比开场：内门外门一起比，观主坐在台北面的竹椅上。抽签，你对外门的何七，孙二狗对内门的卢方。你的头一场，催动一张喷嚏符，一缕黑烟钻进何七的口鼻，他打着喷嚏，叫你一推，下了台。
recap.en: The eighth of the twelfth month, the sect contest opens, inner court and outer court together, the abbot in a bamboo chair north of the stage. The lots: you against He Qi of the outer court, Sun Ergou against Lu Fang of the inner court. In your first bout you woke a sneezing charm; a thread of black smoke shot into He Qi's nose and mouth, and mid-sneeze you pushed him off the stage.

zh: 腊月初八，宗门大比。观主到了。
规矩三条。前四，进内门名册；头名，筑基丹一枚。
抽签：沈小满，对外门何七。孙二狗，对内门卢方。
en: The eighth of the twelfth month: the sect contest. The abbot has come.
Three rules. The last four go into the inner register; first place, one Foundation pill.
The lots: Shen Xiaoman against He Qi of the outer court. Sun Ergou against Lu Fang of the inner court.

story.zh:
大比的台子搭在外门的演武场上，叫五行台——台上并没有五行，只有五块石头。末了剩下三十二个，捉对厮杀，输一场便下去。台上不许伤人性命，打死了人，赢了也算输。打进前四的，进内门名册；头名，得那一颗筑基丹。

辰时，观主到了。他在台北面一张竹椅上坐下，拢着手，面目温和，像来看一场社戏。

抽签的时候，周衡捧着大比的名录。有一页上，头名那一行的名字给人拿笔划了一道，底下的名字给水渍洇开了，看不清写的是什么。

小满问道：「周师兄，这一个怎么划了？」周衡头也不抬：「划了的，是不在观里了的。」小满道：「死了？」周衡道：「不在观里了。账上只记在不在，不记为什么。」说罢冲他一伸手，「抽签。」执事念道：「沈小满——对，外门何七。」轮到孙二狗，执事念道：「孙二狗——对，内门卢方。」台下有人笑出了声。

小满的头一场，打得最快，也最难看。何七是进门三年的老弟子，三层，上了台，一拳当胸打过来。
story.en:
The contest stage was set up on the outer sect's training ground. It had a big name, the Five Phases Stage, though there were no five phases on it, only five stones. In the end thirty-two were left, to fight in pairs, out after one loss. No taking life on the stage; kill someone and even if you win, it counts as a loss. Those who reached the last four went into the inner sect's register; the first place got that one Foundation Pill.

At the hour of the dragon the Abbot arrived. He sat down in a bamboo chair on the north side of the stage, his hands tucked in, mild of face, as if he'd come to watch a village opera.

For the drawing of lots, Zhou Heng sat beside the bamboo tube holding the contest register. On one page, the name in the first-place line had a stroke drawn through it with a brush; the name under it had been blurred by a water stain, and you couldn't read what it said.

Xiaoman asked: "Senior Brother Zhou, why's this one crossed out?" Zhou Heng didn't look up: "The crossed-out ones are the ones who aren't in the abbey any more." Xiaoman said: "Dead?" Zhou Heng said: "Not in the abbey any more. The books only record whether someone's here, not why." With that he held out his hand to him. "Draw." The steward read out: "Shen Xiaoman, against He Qi of the outer sect." When it was Sun Ergou's turn, the steward read out: "Sun Ergou, against Lu Fang of the inner sect." Somebody below laughed out loud.

Xiaoman's first bout was the quickest and the ugliest. He Qi was an older disciple three years in, third layer. He came up on the stage and threw a punch straight at his chest.

story_full.zh:
大比的台子搭在外门的演武场上，五块青石板拼成一个圆，缝里都长出了草，名字倒大，叫五行台——台上并没有五行，只有五块石头。演武场四角，立着四棵老柏。宗门大比，内门外门一起比，向来一日打完：内门二十来个练气弟子，外门一百三十来个，两本名册并在一处抽签。外门的人一看内门那二十来个名字，大半都画了圈，末了剩下三十二个，捉对厮杀，输一场便下去。名录头一页上写着三条：掉下台的，输；认输的，输；执事看着不能再打了的，输。一场只给半炷香，香到了还分不出，执事看谁占着上风。底下还有一条，字写得最大：台上不许伤人性命，打死了人，赢了也算输。打进前四的，进内门名册；头名，得那一颗筑基丹。

辰时，观主到了。他从正殿那边一步一步走下来，演武场上两百来号人，说话的、跺脚取暖的，一下子都没了声，连台角那炷香的烟，都直直地立着不晃。他在台北面一张竹椅上坐下，拢着手，面目温和，像来看一场社戏。

抽签的时候，周衡坐在竹筒旁边，捧着大比的名录。那名录是一本老账簿，蓝布面，边角都给翻烂了，前头几十页记的是历年的大比，一年一页，一页上头一行，写的是那一年的冠军——近三十年的，一行一行，都是内门的名字。小满排到周衡跟前，瞧见那名录正翻在前头，墨色从新到旧，旧到后来，黄得像秋天的树叶。有一页上，头名那一行的名字给人拿笔划了一道，划得很直，划过去的墨比字的墨还新些，底下的名字给水渍洇开了，看不清写的是什么。

小满问道：「周师兄，这一个怎么划了？」周衡头也不抬：「划了的，是不在观里了的。」小满道：「死了？」周衡道：「不在观里了。账上只记在不在，不记为什么。为什么，不归我管。」说罢冲他一伸手，「抽签。」小满把手伸进竹筒里。执事念道：「沈小满——对，外门何七。」轮到孙二狗，执事念道：「孙二狗——对，内门卢方。」台下有人笑出了声。

小满的头一场，打得最快，也最难看。何七是进门三年的老弟子，三层，上了台，冲他一抱拳，一拳当胸打过来。
story_full.en:
The contest stage was set up on the outer sect's training ground: five bluestone slabs fitted into a circle, grass growing in the cracks. It had a big name, the Five Phases Stage, though there were no five phases on it, only five stones. At the four corners of the training ground stood four old cypresses. The sect's Grand Contest was fought by inner and outer sect together, and always finished in a single day: twenty-odd inner-sect Qi Condensation disciples, a hundred and thirty-odd from the outer sect, the two registers put together for the drawing of lots. Most of the outer sect took one look at the inner sect's twenty-odd names and drew a circle round their own, withdrawing. In the end thirty-two were left, to fight in pairs, out after one loss. On the first page of the register three rules were written: whoever falls off the stage loses; whoever concedes loses; whoever the steward judges can't fight on loses. Each bout got half an incense stick; if it was still undecided when the stick burned down, the steward judged who had the upper hand. Below that was one more rule, written in the biggest letters: no taking life on the stage; kill someone and even if you win, it counts as a loss. Those who reached the last four went into the inner sect's register; the first place got that one Foundation Pill.

At the hour of the dragon the Abbot arrived. He came down step by step from the direction of the main hall, and of the two hundred-odd people on the training ground, talking, stamping their feet to keep warm, all at once there wasn't a sound; even the smoke of the incense stick at the stage's corner stood straight up without a waver. He sat down in a bamboo chair on the north side of the stage, his hands tucked in, mild of face, as if he'd come to watch a village opera.

For the drawing of lots, Zhou Heng sat beside the bamboo tube holding the contest register. The register was an old ledger with a blue cloth cover, its corners thumbed to rags. The first few dozen pages recorded the contests of past years, one year to a page, and the top line of each page was that year's champion: the last thirty years, line after line, all inner-sect names. When Xiaoman reached Zhou Heng he saw the register lying open near the front, the ink going from new to old, and old in the end to yellow, like autumn leaves. On one page, the name in the first-place line had a stroke drawn through it with a brush, very straight, and the ink of the stroke was newer than the ink of the name; the name under it had been blurred by a water stain, and you couldn't read what it said.

Xiaoman asked: "Senior Brother Zhou, why's this one crossed out?" Zhou Heng didn't look up: "The crossed-out ones are the ones who aren't in the abbey any more." Xiaoman said: "Dead?" Zhou Heng said: "Not in the abbey any more. The books only record whether someone's here, not why. Why isn't my business." With that he held out his hand to him. "Draw." Xiaoman put his hand into the bamboo tube. The steward read out: "Shen Xiaoman, against He Qi of the outer sect." When it was Sun Ergou's turn, the steward read out: "Sun Ergou, against Lu Fang of the inner sect." Somebody below laughed out loud.

Xiaoman's first bout was the quickest and the ugliest. He Qi was an older disciple three years in, third layer. He came up on the stage, cupped his fist at him in salute, and threw a punch straight at his chest.

label.en: He Qi walks off the stage himself

exits.means: steps up for the first round; He Qi goes off the stage by himself

story.zh:
小满只得往旁边一让，两根指头捏着那张喷嚏符，往里送了一丝灵气。

「嗤」地冒出一缕黑烟，笔直地钻进了何七的鼻孔和嘴里。何七脸一皱：「阿——」又一皱：「阿——嚏！」第三个打到一半，小满在他背上轻轻一推。执事也愣了一下，才道：「沈小满，胜。」孙二狗一本正经地跟旁边的人道：「沈师兄这一招，叫打喷嚏。」

老槐树底下，钱掌柜把「一赔一百五」抹了，写上「一赔一百」。孙二狗挤过去：「掌柜的，我天亮押的那一文，是一百五！」钱掌柜头也不抬：「押出去的，照押出去的算。」
story.en:
Xiaoman could only step aside. He held the Sneezing Talisman between two fingers and sent a thread of spirit qi into it.

With a *tss* a wisp of black smoke came out, and went straight into He Qi's nostrils and mouth. His face screwed up: "Ah—" It screwed up again: "Ah—*choo*!" Halfway through the third Xiaoman gave him a light push in the back. Even the steward was taken aback a moment before he said: "Shen Xiaoman wins." Sun Ergou told the person next to him in all seriousness: "Senior Brother Shen's move there. It's called Sneezing."

Under the old pagoda tree, Shopkeeper Qian rubbed out "a hundred and fifty to one" and wrote "a hundred to one." Sun Ergou squeezed over: "Shopkeeper, the copper I bet at daybreak was at a hundred and fifty!" Shopkeeper Qian didn't look up: "What's been bet goes at what it was bet at."

story_full.zh:
小满昨夜叫饭桶吸了四口，丹田里只剩个底，腿还是软的，接不住，只得往旁边一让；让开的那一霎，他两根指头捏着那张喷嚏符，往里送了一丝灵气。符上那只朱砂鼻子一皱——封在纸里的那道法醒了，「嗤」地冒出一缕黑烟，细得像一根线，笔直地钻进了何七的鼻孔和嘴里。何七一拳打空，转过身来，脸一皱：「阿——」又一皱：「阿——嚏！」一个喷嚏打得他往后一仰，第二个打得他往前一栽，第三个打到一半，小满在他背上轻轻一推。何七一面「嚏！嚏！」，一面自己下了台，落了地还在打，打得眼泪鼻涕一齐下来；小满指头间那张黄纸，已经成了一撮灰，落在冻土上。台下没几个人看清，执事也愣了一下，才道：「沈小满，胜。」人堆里，孙二狗伸长了脖子，一本正经地跟旁边的人道：「沈师兄这一招，叫打喷嚏。」

老槐树底下，钱掌柜把「一赔一百五」抹了，写上「一赔一百」。孙二狗挤过去，脸涨得通红：「掌柜的，我天亮押的那一文，是一百五！」钱掌柜头也不抬：「押出去的，照押出去的算。」
story_full.en:
Last night the Rice Bucket had drawn four breaths from Xiaoman, and there was only the bottom left in his dantian, and his legs were still weak. He couldn't take it, and could only step aside. In the instant of stepping aside, he held the Sneezing Talisman between two fingers and sent a thread of spirit qi into it. The cinnabar nose on the talisman wrinkled; the spell sealed in the paper woke, and with a *tss* a wisp of black smoke came out, thin as a thread, and went straight into He Qi's nostrils and mouth. He Qi's punch hit nothing. He turned round and his face screwed up: "Ah—" It screwed up again: "Ah—*choo*!" One sneeze threw him back, the second pitched him forward, and halfway through the third Xiaoman gave him a light push in the back. Still going "*Choo! Choo!*", He Qi took himself off the stage, and was still sneezing when he hit the ground, sneezing till the tears and snot came together. The yellow paper between Xiaoman's fingers had already turned to a pinch of ash and fallen on the frozen earth. Few below had seen it clearly; even the steward was taken aback a moment before he said: "Shen Xiaoman wins." In the crowd, Sun Ergou craned his neck and told the person next to him in all seriousness: "Senior Brother Shen's move there. It's called Sneezing."

Under the old pagoda tree, Shopkeeper Qian rubbed out "a hundred and fifty to one" and wrote "a hundred to one." Sun Ergou squeezed over, red in the face: "Shopkeeper, the copper I bet at daybreak was at a hundred and fifty!" Shopkeeper Qian didn't look up: "What's been bet goes at what it was bet at."

refuse.zh: 何七的拳头还在半空里——先让开那一拳。
refuse.en: He Qi's fist is still in the air — step aside from that punch first.

_beats: 古六 (2026-10-15): 喷嚏符 · 让一拳 (dabi-sneeze) — 何七 has no creatures.json row, so the bout is the book's reading of it played: the scene's story now ends on 「一拳当胸打过来」 and the way on (`up`) tells the rest after the board.
